A '''Heads-Up Targeting Holographic Projector''' was a [[Computer/Legends|computerized]] targeting system installed on [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn's]] [[PLX-2M portable missile launcher]]. The [[Heads-up display/Legends|heads-up display]] utilized [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] to display information such as range and speed to the [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher's]] user.<ref name="EGWT" />
